about: Rules for the Setups screener. The web app starts from these and lets you change them on your device; the daily build and alerts use this file. Export your on-screen rules from the Setups tab to replace it.

email.note: Needs repo secrets SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS, ALERT_EMAIL_TO (Gmail: an app password).

whatsapp.note: Needs repo secrets WHATSAPP_TOKEN, WHATSAPP_PHONE_ID, WHATSAPP_TO (Meta WhatsApp Cloud API).
